texts.text:
乘坐自动扶梯抵达。罕见现象。
 Arrival by escalator. UNCOMMON PHENOMENON.
texts.speaker:
监工
 Overseer

texts.text:
有何贵干？我很期待。检测到废物处理例外情况。
 What business? Looking forward to it. WASTE DISPOSAL EXCEPTION FLAGGED.
texts.speaker:
监工
 Overseer

texts.text:
声音的主人身形庞大，我们只能把脖子仰到极限，才勉强看清他的脸。
 The owner of the voice was so enormous that we had to crane our necks to their limit merely to find his face.

你们属于异常。抵达这一层的物体通常不会乘坐自动扶梯。超出范围的实体。
 You are anomalous. Objects reaching this floor don't normally arrive on an escalator. OUT-OF-RANGE ENTITIES.
texts.speaker:
监工
 Overseer

texts.text:
不符合常识。需要进行身份确认。
 Not consistent with common sense. IDENTIFICATION REQUIRED.
texts.speaker:
监工
 Overseer

texts.text:
我本以为以实玛利会说些什么来解释何谓常识、何谓非常识，但她保持了沉默。我想，她走到这一步见过太多，已经懒得再纠结语义了。
 I expected Ishmael to come back with something about what counted as common sense and what didn't, but she stayed quiet. I suppose she had seen too much by this point to split hairs over semantics.

那存在突然俯下庞大的身躯，直到与以实玛利四目相对。
 The being suddenly bent his massive body down until it was eye to eye with Ishmael.

请保持冷静。目前没有敌意。
 Please remain calm. NO HOSTILE INTENT AT PRESENT.
texts.speaker:
监工
 Overseer

texts.text:
它巨大的甲壳上布满了孔洞，每个孔洞里都嵌着一张圆脸，直勾勾地盯着我们。
 Its massive carapace was riddled with holes, each one holding something like a round face that stared straight at us.

那些脸在甲壳内部各自转动，向四面八方窥视。眼前的景象唤起了一种我既无法命名、也无法摆脱的恐惧。
 The faces swiveled independently within the shell, peering every which way. The sight stirred a dread I could neither name nor shake.

……让我想起了鲸鱼。
 ... It reminds me of a Whale.
texts.speaker:
以实玛利
 Ishmael

texts.text:
<……你这么一说，孔手之鲸身上确实有个部位看起来和这个存在的甲壳很像……>
 <... Now that you mention it, the Whale of the Porous Hand had a part that looked like this entity's carapace...>
texts.speaker:
但丁
 Dante

texts.text:
……嗯。观察中。
 ... Hm. OBSERVING.
texts.speaker:
监工
 Overseer

texts.text:
现在……似乎还没有让恐惧扎根的理由。
 There seems... little cause to let terror take root just yet.
texts.speaker:
李箱
 Yi Sang

texts.text:
它或许只是在满足自己的好奇心。
 It may merely be indulging its curiosity.
texts.speaker:
李箱
 Yi Sang

texts.text:
逻辑认知优先于欲望。不太可能属于人台分类。
 Logical cognition taking priority over desire. MANNEQUIN CLASSIFICATION UNLIKELY.
texts.speaker:
监工
 Overseer

texts.text:
鲸鱼是什么？
 What's a Whale?
texts.speaker:
布布
 Pwie

texts.text:
……你要我解释鲸鱼？有一小时速成课，还有十二小时强化讲座，如果你胆子够大的话……
 ... You want me to explain Whales? There's the 1-hour crash course, or the 12-hour crash lecture if you're feeling brave...
texts.speaker:
以实玛利
 Ishmael

texts.text:
那是开玩笑的。下次我会从头到尾给你讲一遍。下次……
 That was a joke. I'll give you chapter and verse another time. Another time...
texts.speaker:
以实玛利
 Ishmael

texts.text:
“下次”是什么时候？
 When is "another time"?
texts.speaker:
布布
 Pwie

texts.text:
百货商场里没有鲸鱼吗？
 Are there no Whales here in the department store?
texts.speaker:
布布
 Pwie

texts.text:
理解。确认理解。观察结束。
 Understood. Understanding verified. OBSERVATION CLOSED.
texts.speaker:
监工
 Overseer

texts.text:
你身上带着……香气。那是高声望顾客的气味……
 You carry... a fragrance. The scent of a customer of high Prestige...
texts.speaker:
监工
 Overseer

texts.text:
……必须优先接待。
 ... PRIORITY HOSPITALITY REQUIRED.
texts.speaker:
监工
 Overseer

texts.text:
<也许只是闻到了肥厚的钱包味……>
 <Maybe it just smells a fat wallet...>
texts.speaker:
但丁
 Dante

texts.text:
在寻找特定的皮革吗？一路来到“底层”，说明你们很急，对吧？加急订单。需要支付附加费。
 Looking for a particular hide? Coming all the way down to the "bottom" means you're in a rush, yes? RUSH ORDER. SURCHARGE REQUIRED.
texts.speaker:
监工
 Overseer

texts.text:
我们需要——
 We require—
texts.speaker:
默尔索
 Meursault

texts.text:
明白了。你们需要定制服装。
 Understood. You require bespoke attire.
texts.speaker:
监工
 Overseer

texts.text:
预定穿着者……确认。
 Intended wearer... confirmed.
texts.speaker:
监工
 Overseer

texts.text:
那存在继续向下弯曲，将脸凑到与布布齐平，而不是与我们任何一个人齐平。
 The being bent lower still, bringing its face level not with any of us... but with Pwie.

陪同顾客的实体预计会返回上层。长期居留可能性极低。确认属于陌生者分类。
 Accompanying customers are temporary entities expected to return upstairs. LONG-TERM RESIDENCY IMPROBABLE. STRANGER CLASSIFICATION CONFIRMED.
texts.speaker:
监工
 Overseer

texts.text:
我很好奇陌生者存在的本质。将迷失的存在送回原本的位置：这就是陌生者的命运吗？形成新的疑问。
 I am curious as to the nature of the strangers' existence. To return a lost being to their original position: the strangers' lot? NEW QUERY FORMED.
texts.speaker:
监工
 Overseer

texts.text:
即便是承载着自身存在的我们，也无法说清它的罗盘究竟指向何方……
 Even we who bear our existence cannot say where its compass truly points...
texts.speaker:
李箱
 Yi Sang

texts.text:
那么……你就是能做衣服的人？我们有预算，但也不是由眼球堆成的……所以付不了太多。
 Then... are you the one who can make the outfit? We have a budget, but we are not exactly made of eyeballs, so... we can't pay much.
texts.speaker:
以实玛利
 Ishmael

texts.text:
眼球只是附带之物。重要的是材料。
 Eyeballs are incidental. The material is what is important.
texts.speaker:
监工
 Overseer

texts.text:
黄金皮革服装需要大量黄金皮革，但我们已经没有存货了。库存耗尽。
 A Golden Hide garment requires a large amount of Golden Hide, but we have none left. STOCK DEPLETED.
texts.speaker:
监工
 Overseer

texts.text:
……过去我们经常接到这样的高级订单。那真是令人兴奋的日子。表达失望。
 ... We used to receive many premium commissions like this. Those were the exciting days. DISAPPOINTMENT EXPRESSED.
texts.speaker:
监工
 Overseer

texts.text:
以前有很多吗？
 There used to be a lot?
texts.speaker:
布布
 Pwie

texts.text:
确实。那是久远到我几乎记不清的许多个季节以前……这一层曾经有大量黄金皮革。丰饶时代。
 Indeed. It was so many seasons ago that I barely remember... but this floor once held a great deal of Golden Hide. AGE OF ABUNDANCE.
texts.speaker:
监工
 Overseer

texts.text:
那些都去哪儿了？
 Where did all of it go?
texts.speaker:
布布
 Pwie

texts.text:
散落在百货商场各处。每个角落都有。
 Scattered throughout the department store. Every corner.
texts.speaker:
监工
 Overseer

texts.text:
你不会真想让我们自己把百货商场的每个角落都搜一遍吧。
 You can't seriously mean we have to search every nook and cranny of the department store ourselves.
texts.speaker:
以实玛利
 Ishmael

texts.text:
当然不会。没有顾客能搜遍整座百货商场。它总在变化，也总会回来。
 Of course not. No customer could search the entire department store. It is always changing and returning.
texts.speaker:
监工
 Overseer

texts.text:
嗯……
 Hmm...
texts.speaker:
李箱
 Yi Sang

texts.text:
或许……你也想亲眼见证这样的作品？一件由许多张黄金皮革织成的黄金皮革服装。
 Perhaps... you, too, wish to behold such a work with your own eyes? A Golden Hide garment woven from many sheets of Golden Hide.
texts.speaker:
李箱
 Yi Sang

texts.text:
对于一位对服装艺术抱有热情的求知之人来说，这样的愿望再自然不过……
 For an inquiring soul with a passion for the sartorial arts, such a desire would be only natural...
texts.speaker:
李箱
 Yi Sang

texts.text:
嗯。这个提议有道理。黄金皮革服装已经消失了许多个季节，也许再也不会出现。遗憾与期待交汇。
 Hm. The proposal has merit. Golden Hide garments have been absent for many seasons and may never be available again. REGRET AND ANTICIPATION INTERSECT.
texts.speaker:
监工
 Overseer

texts.text:
而且，凭你那双老练的眼睛……你肯定知道该收集哪些黄金皮革……不是吗？
 Moreover, one possessing your seasoned eye... should surely know which Golden Hides must be gathered... would you not?
texts.speaker:
李箱
 Yi Sang

texts.text:
你不正是一名毕生从事这门生意、双手从未离开皮革的专业人士吗？
 Are you not a professional who spent a lifetime in this trade, with hide ever beneath your hands?
texts.speaker:
李箱
 Yi Sang

texts.text:
我喜欢你称我为“专业人士”。激发野心。
 I like how you call me a "professional." AMBITION DRIVE STIMULATED.
texts.speaker:
监工
 Overseer

texts.text:
我会扫描百货商场剩余的黄金皮革，并确定这份订单所需的样本。
 I will scan the department store's remaining Golden Hides and determine the specimens required for this commission.
texts.speaker:
监工
 Overseer

texts.text:
那就放心了。我刚才还以为我们得在这里永远漫无目的地游荡……
 That's a relief. For a moment, I thought we had to wander around this whole place forever...
texts.speaker:
以实玛利
 Ishmael

texts.text:
呃啊……！
 Hrrrngh...!
texts.speaker:
监工
 Overseer

texts.text:
随着那存在发出用力的叫声，甲壳上嵌着的几张脸同时消失。
 At the entity's cry of exertion, several of the faces embedded across the carapace vanished at once.

我看见了……目标锁定。
 I can see it... TARGET LOCKED.
texts.speaker:
监工
 Overseer

texts.text:
顾客必须收集的黄金皮革。我们必须制作的黄金皮革。曾从我们手中滑落的黄金皮革……
 Golden Hides the customers must gather. Golden Hides we must fashion. Golden Hides that slipped from our hands...
texts.speaker:
监工
 Overseer

texts.text:
每一块都已定位。确认踪迹。
 Every one of them is located. TRAIL CONFIRMED.
texts.speaker:
监工
 Overseer

texts.text:
要完成订单，黄金皮革必须与顾客先前的路线相交。谜题拼合完成。
 Completion requires Golden Hides to intersect the customers' prior routes. PUZZLE PIECED.
texts.speaker:
监工
 Overseer

texts.text:
任务似乎已经完成，那些消失的脸重新滑回甲壳上各自的孔洞。
 Their task apparently complete, the vanished faces slid back into their individual sockets across the carapace.

我会告诉你们皮革的位置。你们记得住东西，对吧？怀疑陌生者的智力。
 I will tell you the location of the Hides. You can remember things, can't you? DOUBTING STRANGERS' INTELLIGENCE.
texts.speaker:
监工
 Overseer

texts.text:
列出位置。我会记住。
 List the locations. I will remember them.
texts.speaker:
默尔索
 Meursault

texts.text:
既然如此……
 In that case...
texts.speaker:
监工
 Overseer

texts.text:
那存在背诵了我们必须取得的全部黄金皮革清单。
 The being recited the complete list of Golden Hides we would have to obtain.

所以……黄金皮革必须来自我们已经见过或路过的人？
 So... the Golden Hide has to come from someone we've already met or passed along the way?
texts.speaker:
以实玛利
 Ishmael

texts.text:
是的，关键就在这里。定制服装必须用被顾客触碰过，或被他们经过时留下痕迹的皮革制成。
 Yes, that is the crucial part. A bespoke garment must be made from Hides touched by the customers or marked by their passage.
texts.speaker:
监工
 Overseer

texts.text:
清单上的某些对象……恐怕不会轻易交出黄金皮革。
 Some among those listed... seem unlikely to part with their Golden Hide without a struggle.
texts.speaker:
李箱
 Yi Sang

texts.text:
那是陌生者必须克服的问题。黄金皮革是通过征服百货商场中的事物才能获得的珍贵资源。预期将经历艰苦旅程。
 That problem is for the strangers to overcome. The Golden Hide is a valuable resource obtained through conquest in this department store. ARDUOUS JOURNEY ANTICIPATED.
texts.speaker:
监工
 Overseer

texts.text:
把我点名的每一块黄金皮革带来，我的孩子们会制作服装。分担工作量。
 Bring every Golden Hide I named, and my children will make the garment. WORKLOAD DIVISION.
texts.speaker:
监工
 Overseer

texts.text:
不管怎样，谢谢你……什么都没要求就帮了这么大的忙。你知道的，楼上的每个人都只顾着眼球……
 In any case, thanks... This is a lot of help without asking for anything. Everyone upstairs was obsessed with eyeballs, you know...
texts.speaker:
以实玛利
 Ishmael

texts.text:
当然，眼球是另一回事。更新账簿。
 Of course, the eyeballs are a separate matter. UPDATE LEDGER.
texts.speaker:
监工
 Overseer

texts.text:
账簿更新完毕！
 Ledger updated!
texts.speaker:
刮肉工
 Scraper

texts.text:
嗯……好吧。
 Uh-huh... Right.
texts.speaker:
以实玛利
 Ishmael

texts.text: 世上没有什么东西不带价签。即便是在这座百货商场的内部…… Nothing in the world comes without a price tag. Even here, in the confines of this department store...
texts.speaker:
李箱
 Yi Sang

texts.text:
以前制革工更多，能分到手的皮革也更多。如今只剩下退休的那些人。生意紧得很，只能从剩下的生皮上刮肉，再按碎屑卖出去。
 There used to be more hideworkers—more hides to go around. Now only the retired ones are left. Business is so tight that we scrape meat from leftover rawhide and sell it by the scrap.
texts.speaker:
刮肉工
 Scraper

texts.text:
看来前方是一条荆棘之路。
 It seems a thorny road lies ahead.
texts.speaker:
李箱
 Yi Sang

texts.text:
*叹气* 我猜也没别的办法了。
 *sigh* No way around it, I guess.
texts.speaker:
以实玛利
 Ishmael

texts.text:
你在叹气。艰难的时候才会叹气。
 You're sighing. Sigh is for hard times.
texts.speaker:
布布
 Pwie

texts.text:
做衣服一定很难。
 Making clothes must be hard, then.
texts.speaker:
布布
 Pwie

texts.text:
或许只是因为，年幼的布布的衣服格外难做……
 Perhaps it is simply that young Pwie's garment is uniquely difficult to make...
texts.speaker:
李箱
 Yi Sang

texts.text:
为什么？
 Why?
texts.speaker:
布布
 Pwie

texts.text:
是因为我在这座百货商场里……既高贵又可憎吗？
 Is it because I'm... both noble and abominable in this department store?
texts.speaker:
布布
 Pwie

texts.text:
嗯……我会说更像是“特别”。
 Hmm... more like "special," I'd say.
texts.speaker:
以实玛利
 Ishmael

texts.text:
你们不崇拜我，也不觉得我恶心。
 You don't worship me, and you don't find me disgusting.
texts.speaker:
布布
 Pwie

texts.text:
你们不向我要眼球，反而花眼球来给我买东西。
 You don't ask me for eyeballs. Instead, you pay eyeballs to buy me things.
texts.speaker:
布布
 Pwie

texts.text:
所以你们很奇怪。
 That's why you're strange.
texts.speaker:
布布
 Pwie

texts.text:
就连现在，你们还在叹气……可你们还是在努力给我做衣服。
 Even now, you're sighing... But you're still trying to make clothes for me.
texts.speaker:
布布
 Pwie

texts.text:
正如恶意并不总是源于理性，善意也不必放上商人的秤来衡量。
 Just as malice is not always born of reason, kindness need not be weighed upon a merchant's scale.
texts.speaker:
李箱
 Yi Sang

texts.text:
想想看，布布：你也在乎这只虫子——
 Consider this, Pwie: you, too, care for this bug—
texts.speaker:
李箱
 Yi Sang

texts.text:
不是“虫子”。是“蠕蠕”。
 It's not "bug." It's "Wriggley."
texts.speaker:
布布
 Pwie

texts.text:
我、我很抱歉。你也足够在乎蠕蠕，不愿让它承受痛苦，不是吗？可蠕蠕并没有为这样的温柔付出任何代价。
 M-my apologies. You, too, care for Wriggley enough to spare it from pain, do you not? Yet Wriggley has paid no price for such tenderness.
texts.speaker:
李箱
 Yi Sang

texts.text:
那是……因为……
 That's... because...
texts.speaker:
布布
 Pwie

texts.text:
……我不知道该怎么解释。
 ... I dunno how to explain it.
texts.speaker:
布布
 Pwie

texts.text:
那么在这方面，我们或许十分相似。心已经做出选择的地方，语言往往会失效。
 Then perhaps we are much the same in that regard. Language often fails where the heart has already chosen.
texts.speaker:
李箱
 Yi Sang

texts.text:
<我心里有点矛盾。>
 <I'm feeling a bit conflicted.>
texts.speaker:
但丁
 Dante

texts.text:
经理，可以问问原因吗？
 May I ask why, Manager?
texts.speaker:
默尔索
 Meursault

texts.text:
<其实，我们……>
 <The truth is, we...>
texts.speaker:
但丁
 Dante

texts.text:
<表面上看，我们似乎完全是为了布布才做这些衣服，可是……>
 <On the surface, it looks as though we're making these clothes entirely for Pwie's sake, but...>
texts.speaker:
但丁
 Dante

texts.text:
是的。严格来说，我们的目标并非利他，而是要得到与先前不同的结果。
 Yes. Strictly speaking, our objective is not aimed at altruism, but at producing a different outcome from the previous one.
texts.speaker:
默尔索
 Meursault

texts.text:
<没错。但布布不知道这一点。>
 <Right. But Pwie doesn't know that.>
texts.speaker:
但丁
 Dante

texts.text:
即使告诉布布，它也无法理解完整的前提。
 Even if we told Pwie, the entity would not comprehend the full premise.
texts.speaker:
默尔索
 Meursault

texts.text:
<我知道，可是……还是感觉很糟，像是我们无意中欺骗了布布。>
 <I know, but... it still feels awful, like we're deceiving Pwie without meaning to.>
texts.speaker:
但丁
 Dante

texts.text:
如您所知，我们称为“布布”的存在只能在这里存在。它无法离开大百货商场。
 The entity we call "Pwie" can exist only here, as you are already aware. It cannot exist outside the Grand Magasin.
texts.speaker:
默尔索
 Meursault

texts.text:
<我知道……可我们一起说过的话、一起度过的时间呢？现在我们之间已经有了真实的联系。>
 <I know... But what about all the talking and time we spent together? We have a real connection with them now.>
texts.speaker:
但丁
 Dante

texts.text:
这是一个没有答案的困境。沉溺于这种感情只会加重您的痛苦，经理。
 It's a dilemma that has no answer. Dwelling on such feelings will only worsen your distress, Manager.
texts.speaker:
默尔索
 Meursault

texts.text:
<……大概吧。不过……我不想对自己的感受视而不见……>
 <... Probably. Still... I don't want to look away from what I'm feeling...>
texts.speaker:
但丁
 Dante

texts.text:
……明白了。
 ... Understood.
texts.speaker:
默尔索
 Meursault

texts.text:
处理完成。
 Processing completed.
texts.speaker:
监工
 Overseer

texts.text:
这里是制革工坊。我们对皮革进行各种处理，防止它腐烂。
 This is the tannery. It processes various treatments to leather to prevent it from rotting.
texts.speaker:
制革工坊
 Tannery

texts.text:
……当我把手放在自动扶梯的皮革扶手上……扶手的速度竟然和我完全一致……
 ... When, after placing my hand over the leather handrail of an escalator... the speed of the railing exactly matches my own...
texts.speaker:
培育者
 Nurturer

texts.text:
上层顾客带回了所需的全部黄金皮革。惊叹与赞赏。
 The upper-tier customers returned with every required Golden Hide. AMAZEMENT AND COMPLIMENTS.
texts.speaker:
监工
 Overseer

texts.text:
收集工作与我无关……我会欣然将这份赞赏转交给承担重担的人。
 I bore no part in the gathering... I shall kindly relay that praise at the feet of those who carried the burden.
texts.speaker:
李箱
 Yi Sang

texts.text:
现在你能做黄金皮革服装了，对吧？
 Now you can make the Golden Hide outfit, right?
texts.speaker:
以实玛利
 Ishmael

texts.text:
黄金皮革高级定制不是打个响指就能完成的。顾客的常识不足。
 Golden Hide couture cannot be produced at the snap of a finger. CUSTOMER COMMON SENSE DEFICIENT.
texts.speaker:
监工
 Overseer

texts.text:
你的意思是，收集材料并不是唯一要做的事？
 You mean collecting the materials was not the only errand?
texts.speaker:
以实玛利
 Ishmael

texts.text:
顾客从来没有定制过衣服吗？难以理解正在加深。
 Have the customers never commissioned bespoke clothing? INCOMPREHENSION RISING.
texts.speaker:
监工
 Overseer

texts.text:
……没有。你知道巢里一套定制服装要多少钱吗？
 ... No, we haven't. Do you have any idea how much a single bespoke suit costs inside a Nest?
texts.speaker:
以实玛利
 Ishmael

texts.text:
……顾客似乎没有最初看起来那么富裕。身份降级。
 ... Customers appear less affluent than they initially appeared. STATUS DOWNGRADED.
texts.speaker:
监工
 Overseer

texts.text:
……他似乎每交换一句话，就变得更加坦率……
 ... He appears to grow more candid with each word traded...
texts.speaker:
李箱
 Yi Sang

texts.text:
所有皮革都要经过处理阶段。观察处理过程。第一步是测量尺寸。优先进行实用测量。
 All hides pass through processing stages. Process observation. The first step is to get their size. PRACTICAL MEASUREMENTS PRIORITIZED.
texts.speaker:
监工
 Overseer

texts.text:
制革工负责试穿。你们可以在那边的房间找到她。已为你们指路。
 Tanner performs the fittings. You can find her in the room over there. KINDLY DIRECTED.
texts.speaker:
监工
 Overseer

texts.text:
欢迎各位陌生者光临。
 A pleasure to have you, strangers.
texts.speaker:
制革工
 Tanner

texts.text:
你们是来定制黄金之皮的服装，对吧？
 You have come to commission a bespoke garment of Golden Hide, yes?
texts.speaker:
制革工
 Tanner

texts.text:
请问，谁会穿这件衣服？
 May I ask who will be wearing it?
texts.speaker:
制革工
 Tanner

texts.text:
这个孩子。
 This child.
texts.speaker:
李箱
 Yi Sang

texts.text:
我们会以身体本身为基础制作服装，修正每一处缺陷，让每一项优点都得到展现。成衣不过是批量裁剪出来的妥协品。
 We build the garment around the body itself, correcting every flaw and letting every strength take the stage. Ready-to-wear is merely a compromise cut by the dozen.
texts.speaker:
制革工
 Tanner

texts.text:
那么，您喜欢哪种翻领？平驳领？戗驳领？半戗驳领？还是鱼嘴领？
 Now, which type of lapel suits your preference? Notched? Peak? Semi-peak? Or perhaps fish mouth?
texts.speaker:
制革工
 Tanner

texts.text:
那都是什么——
 What are tho—
texts.speaker:
布布
 Pwie

texts.text:
<不不不！暂停！照这个速度下去要耗上一整天。跳过讲解，直接开始制作吧。>
 <Nope, nope! Time out! It's gonna take all day at this rate. Let's skip the lecture and get to crafting.>
texts.speaker:
但丁
 Dante

texts.text:
自行判断即可。交给您了。
 Use your judgment. We'll leave it to you.
texts.speaker:
默尔索
 Meursault

texts.text:
……！我的判断……！也就是说……量身定制……！
 ...! My judgment...! That means... tailor-made...!
texts.speaker:
制革工
 Tanner

texts.text:
很好。我会将所拥有的每一分才能都倾注于针尖，不遗漏任何细节。
 Very well. I will put every talent I possess to the needle and leave no detail wanting.
texts.speaker:
制革工
 Tanner

texts.text:
现在来量尺寸。请往这边走。
 Now, the measurements. This way, please.
texts.speaker:
制革工
 Tanner

texts.text:
制革工以一连串眼花缭乱的动作，让软尺绕着布布飞旋起来，开始为其测量尺寸。
 With a series of dazzling flourishes, the Tanner sent the measuring tape spinning around Pwie and began taking their measurements.

也量量蠕蠕。
 Measure Wriggley too.
texts.speaker:
布布
 Pwie

texts.text:
如您所愿。
 As you wish.
texts.speaker:
制革工
 Tanner

texts.text:
……我明白了。亲爱的顾客，看来您剩下的事情就是……
 ... I understand now. It would seem, dear customer, all that's left for you...
texts.speaker:
制革工
 Tanner

texts.text:
……长成这件衣服的模样……并超越它。
 ... is to grow into the garment... and beyond.
texts.speaker:
制革工
 Tanner

texts.text:
接下来你可有得忙了。
 You will have your hands full from here on.
texts.speaker:
制革工
 Tanner

texts.text:
每当如此珍贵的皮革进入加工环节……粗鲁的边角料商便会聚集而来，希望从中迅速赚上一笔。
 Whenever hide this valuable enters processing... rude scraps gather, hoping to make a quick fortune out of it.
texts.speaker:
制革工
 Tanner

texts.text:
那些从未被妥善鞣制的皮革边角料……
 Offcuts from hides that were never properly tanned...
texts.speaker:
制革工
 Tanner

texts.text:
请阻止他们哪怕碰到作品的一根手指。
 Keep them from laying so much as a finger on the work, please.
texts.speaker:
制革工
 Tanner

texts.text:
<默尔索！敌人正从四面八方包围过来！>
 <Meursault! We've got company closing in from every direction!>
texts.speaker:
但丁
 Dante

texts.text:
收到，经理。
 Acknowledged, Manager.
texts.speaker:
默尔索
 Meursault

texts.text:
好了。完成了。
 There. It is done.
texts.speaker:
制革工
 Tanner

texts.text:
今天来试衣的人还真多。
 Quite a crowd gathered for today's fitting.
texts.speaker:
制革工
 Tanner

texts.text:
我们不过是跟在后面……人群的拥挤却仿佛夺走了我们的呼吸。
 Though we did naught but follow behind... the press of bodies seemed to steal the breath from us.
texts.speaker:
李箱
 Yi Sang

texts.text:
我们不必在制作的每一个阶段都做这种事吧？
 We don't have to do this for every single stage of the process, do we?
texts.speaker:
以实玛利
 Ishmael

texts.text:
图样已经完成。穿针缝制，再裁剪一番，这件衣服就做好了。
 The pattern is complete. One pass beneath the needle, with some stitching and cutting, and the garment will be finished.
texts.speaker:
制革工
 Tanner

texts.text:
前往裁剪室，启动机器。还要留意那些觊觎皮革的顾客。他们可能会……有点暴力。
 Head to the Cutting Room and start up the machine. And keep an eye out for customers who are after the hide. They can get... a bit violent.
texts.speaker:
制革工
 Tanner

texts.text:
等所有皮料都裁好了，就拿到外面，让培育者把它们缝起来。
 Once all the pieces are cut, take them outside and have the Nurturer stitch them up.
texts.speaker:
制革工
 Tanner

texts.text:
<这应该就是裁切机了。>
 <This must be the cutting machine.>
texts.speaker:
但丁
 Dante

texts.text:
经理，我现在启动设备。
 Activating the device now, Manager.
texts.speaker:
默尔索
 Meursault

texts.text:
……！有什么东西过来了。
 ...! Something's coming.
texts.speaker:
以实玛利
 Ishmael

texts.text:
黄金……黄金……黄金皮革……想要……皮革……
 Gold... Gold... Golden Hide... Want... the Hide...
texts.speaker:
爬行皮革
 Crawling Leather

texts.text:
它们似乎觊觎我们正在加工的黄金皮革……
 They appear to covet the Golden Hide we are processing...
texts.speaker:
李箱
 Yi Sang

texts.text:
<机器加工完之前，别让它们靠近。>
 <Let's keep them away until the machine's done with the processing.>
texts.speaker:
但丁
 Dante

texts.text:
听说黄金皮革衣服可以在这里缝制……
 We were told the Golden Hide garment could be sewn here...
texts.speaker:
李箱
 Yi Sang

texts.text:
……布料送进滚烫缝纫机时那尖锐又刺激的声音。把新买的东西上的薄膜一口气撕下来时的感觉。收据恰好沿虚线整齐撕开时，那干净利落的一扯……
 ... The sharp thrilling sound when cloth goes into a hot sewing machine. The feeling of peeling the film off a new purchase in one long riiiiip. The satisfying clean pull when a receipt tears exactly along the dotted line...
texts.speaker:
培育者
 Nurturer

texts.text:
……我们现在又是在玩什么游戏？
 ... What sort of game are we playing now?
texts.speaker:
以实玛利
 Ishmael

texts.text:
游戏？我也想玩。
 Game? I wanna play, too.
texts.speaker:
布布
 Pwie

texts.text:
我在列举那些光是想一想，就能让心里舒服得直哼哼的事情……
 I'm listing thoughts that make the mind purr just by imagining them...
texts.speaker:
培育者
 Nurturer

texts.text:
每次摸到蠕蠕时，那种湿湿滑滑的感觉。
 The damp, slippery feeling whenever I touch Wriggley.
texts.speaker:
布布
 Pwie

texts.text:
朝前看，知道有人可以让我跟着。
 Looking ahead and knowing there is someone I can follow.
texts.speaker:
布布
 Pwie

texts.text:
那个锁链叮当响的人回头看我有没有跟上时，我心里的感觉。
 What I feel when the one whose chains rattle looks back to check that I'm still following.
texts.speaker:
布布
 Pwie

texts.text:
<……你真那么做了？>
 <... You really did that?>
texts.speaker:
但丁
 Dante

texts.text:
是。
 Yes.
texts.speaker:
默尔索
 Meursault

texts.text:
看着大家叹气抱怨……可还是因为衣服是给我的，就去收集材料。
 Watching everyone sigh and complain... then still gather materials because the clothes are for me.
texts.speaker:
布布
 Pwie

texts.text:
嗯……对。都是些让人心情愉快的念头，你说的这些。
 Mmm... yes. All feel-good thoughts, yours.
texts.speaker:
培育者
 Nurturer

texts.text:
想到这些，我也觉得很舒服。趁这感觉还在，我来把黄金皮革缝进你的衣服里。
 Thinking about them makes me feel good. I'll sew the Golden Hide into your clothes while it lasts.
texts.speaker:
培育者
 Nurturer

texts.text:
*吸溜* *吧唧*
 *slurp* *smack*
texts.speaker:
培育者
 Nurturer

texts.text: ……这也算这里的缝纫？ ... That's what passes as sewing here?
texts.speaker:
以实玛利
 Ishmael

texts.text:
以实玛利女士，每个人……不，每位百货公司的员工，想必都有自己缝纫的手法……
 Miss Ishmael, every person... nay, every employee of this department store must have their own technique of sewing...
texts.speaker:
李箱
 Yi Sang

texts.text:
*舔* *吧唧* *吸溜*
 *lick* *smack* *slurp*
texts.speaker:
培育者
 Nurturer

texts.text:
又有东西来了。它们想要我的衣服。
 More are coming. They want my clothes.
texts.speaker:
布布
 Pwie

texts.text:
可那些……不是红派吗？
 But aren't those... the Rouges?
texts.speaker:
以实玛利
 Ishmael

texts.text:
被阳光晃瞎了眼的红派。
 Rouges blinded by the sunlight.
texts.speaker:
默尔索
 Meursault

texts.text:
究竟是什么迷住了它们，让它们连自己想要奉为至高存在的对象都要攻击？
 What has so enthralled them that they would assail even the being they intend to exalt?
texts.speaker:
李箱
 Yi Sang

texts.text:
失明令它们无法辨明该做什么。
 Their blindness keeps them from discerning what must be done.
texts.speaker:
默尔索
 Meursault

texts.text:
<又交给你了，默尔索。>
 <All yours again, Meursault.>
texts.speaker:
但丁
 Dante

texts.text:
明白。
 Understood.
texts.speaker:
默尔索
 Meursault

texts.text:
好了……快完成了。再加最后一样材料，就大功告成。
 There... almost done. One final material and it will be complete.
texts.speaker:
培育者
 Nurturer

texts.text:
你知道我们为了这些材料，在百货公司里来回跑了多少趟吗？虽然不是每一趟我都在，但也……
 Do you have any idea how many laps we've made around this department store for materials? I wasn't there for every run, sure, but still...
texts.speaker:
以实玛利
 Ishmael

texts.text:
哎呀……你这么一说，我心情都变差了……不过你们已经有……需要的材料了……
 Aw... My mood's worsened now... But you already have... the material you need...
texts.speaker:
培育者
 Nurturer

texts.text:
哦，我们有？那你怎么不早说——
 Oh, we do? Well, why didn't you start with that—
texts.speaker:
以实玛利
 Ishmael

texts.text:
黄金之茧。
 The Golden Cocoon.
texts.speaker:
培育者
 Nurturer

texts.text:
得把黄金之茧拧出汁液，涂在衣服上。好好拧上八圈，里面的东西差不多就全挤出来了。
 The Golden Cocoon must be wrung for its extract, which will be used to paint over the garment. Eight good twists should squeeze out nearly everything inside.
texts.speaker:
培育者
 Nurturer

texts.text:
那么蠕蠕——不，那只茧会变成什么样？
 Then what becomes of Wrigg—no, the cocoon?
texts.speaker:
李箱
 Yi Sang

texts.text:
它作为茧的使命便完成了，只剩下一副空壳。不过，空壳摸起来应该也挺舒服，嘿嘿……软软塌塌的……
 Its work as a cocoon will be finished, and only the husk will remain. Still, an empty shell should feel pleasant to touch, heh heh... Soft and limp...
texts.speaker:
培育者
 Nurturer

texts.text:
肯定还有别的办法。比如替代材料，或者换一种工序……
 There has to be another way. A substitute material, maybe, or another process...
texts.speaker:
以实玛利
 Ishmael

texts.text:
只要能把茧用进衣服里，什么办法都行……和衣服融为一体也可以。也就是说，穿衣服的人只要……把它一口吞下去。
 Anything, as long as the Cocoon can be included in the outfit... Becoming one with it should work, too. Meaning, the wearer can simply... gulp it down.
texts.speaker:
培育者
 Nurturer

texts.text:
……蠕蠕会死吗？
 ... Is Wriggley going to die?
texts.speaker:
布布
 Pwie

texts.text:
会。
 Yes.
texts.speaker:
默尔索
 Meursault

texts.text:
因为我的新衣服？
 Because of my new clothing?
texts.speaker:
布布
 Pwie

texts.text:
……对。
 ... Correct.
texts.speaker:
默尔索
 Meursault

texts.text:
那……我不要了。
 Then... I don't want it anymore.
texts.speaker:
布布
 Pwie

texts.text:
哎呀……可就差最后一步了。现在停下来，大家心里都不会好受的。
 Oh no... We only have the last step to go through, though. No one will feel good if you stop now.
texts.speaker:
培育者
 Nurturer

texts.text:
……我不要！
 ... I don't want it!
texts.speaker:
布布
 Pwie

texts.text:
布布猛地扑上前，从默尔索肩头上方抓走了漂浮的茧。
 Pwie lunged forward and snatched the cocoon floating above Meursault's shoulder.

布布双手护着蠕蠕，瞪着培育者，仿佛他下一刻就会来抢走那只茧。
 They cradled Wriggley in both hands and glared at the Nurturer as though he were about to come for the cocoon.

如果你真的不想要衣服，没人能强迫你……但要进五楼，你需要那件衣服，对吧？
 Nobody can force you if you really don't want the clothes... But you need the garment to enter the fifth floor, don't you?
texts.speaker:
以实玛利
 Ishmael

texts.text:
不上去也没关系吗？
 Are you all right with not going up?
texts.speaker:
以实玛利
 Ishmael

texts.text:
那……那也不行……
 That... that can't happen either...
texts.speaker:
布布
 Pwie

texts.text:
如果我不上去……大家会失望的。我的声音就传不出去……我也没法继续往前走……
 If I don't go up... I'll let everyone down. I won't be able to make my voice heard... I won't be able to move forward...
texts.speaker:
布布
 Pwie

texts.text:
我出生的目的……我应该成为的东西……大家对我的期待……那些因为我而熄灭的人……
 The purpose I was born for... the thing I'm supposed to be... what everyone expects from me... everyone who got extinguished because of me...
texts.speaker:
布布
 Pwie

texts.text:
……你一定很苦恼。这条岔路对任何孩子来说，都太残酷了。
 ... You must be deeply troubled. This fork in the road is far too cruel for any child to choose.
texts.speaker:
李箱
 Yi Sang

texts.text:
<……我们回地下一楼吧。去海岸里找，也许像大海捞针，但说不定还能找到一只活着的、带着茧的幼虫。>
 <... Let's return to B1. Scouring through the Shore may be a needle-in-a-haystack job, but we might be able to find another living larva that still has its cocoon.>
texts.speaker:
但丁
 Dante

texts.text:
概率很低。
 The probability is low.
texts.speaker:
默尔索
 Meursault

texts.text:
可是布布那么在乎它。我也说不清，让一个孩子杀死它，实在……
 But Pwie cares for it so much. I don't know, asking a child to kill it is just...
texts.speaker:
以实玛利
 Ishmael

texts.text:
也许很罕见，但某个地方一定还有一只。我们可以继续找。
 It may be rare, but there has to be one more somewhere. We can keep looking.
texts.speaker:
以实玛利
 Ishmael

texts.text:
那就这么办。布布，我们回楼上吧。
 All right, then. Let's head back up, Pwie.
texts.speaker:
以实玛利
 Ishmael

texts.text:
……不，我不能留在楼下。我……我出生是因为……我应该……我……
 ... No, I can't stay downstairs. I'm... I was born because... I'm supposed to... I...
texts.speaker:
布布
 Pwie

texts.text:
我不能再拖下去了。
 I can't put this off anymore.
texts.speaker:
布布
 Pwie

texts.text:
布布……？
 Pwie...?
texts.speaker:
李箱
 Yi Sang

texts.text:
必须填满。空的。一开始就是空的……不够。什么都没有。必须填满。
 Have to fill. Empty. Began empty... Not enough. There's nothing. Have to fill.
texts.speaker:
布布
 Pwie

texts.text:
布布，你在说什么？我听不明白。你是不是哪里不舒服，还是……
 Pwie, what are you saying? You're not making sense. Are you not feeling well or...
texts.speaker:
以实玛利
 Ishmael

texts.text:
布布蜷缩起身体，贴着地面剧烈颤抖。
 Pwie folded in on themselves, trembling violently against the floor.

布布发出的声音，同样透着恐惧与迷醉，仿佛被什么东西附了身。
 The voice that escaped them sounded equally terrified and entranced, as though they'd been possessed by something.

那反应，那沾满赤裸欲望的颤抖……很像……我曾透过堂吉诃德感受到的那股不加掩饰的食欲。
 That reaction, that trembling slick with naked desire... It's a lot like... that raw, unfiltered appetite I'd felt through Don Quixote.

<布布，等等。先把蠕蠕还给默尔索……！>
 <Pwie, wait. Give Wriggley back to Meursault first...!>
texts.speaker:
但丁
 Dante

texts.text:
饿……我太饿了……
 Hungry.... I'm so hungry...
texts.speaker:
布布
 Pwie

texts.text: *尖厉嘶鸣* *screeeeeee*
texts.speaker:
茧
 Cocoon

texts.text:
……呃啊！！
 ... Ghhh!!
texts.speaker:
布布
 Pwie

texts.text:
<……太迟了。>
 <... It's too late.>
texts.speaker:
但丁
 Dante

texts.text:
布布被前所未有的饥饿与贪欲吞没，
 Overtaken by the hunger and greed they must've never felt before,

撕开曾经珍爱的茧，在任何人来得及阻止之前，疯狂地大口吞了下去。
 Pwie tore into the cocoon they had cherished, swallowing it in frantic mouthfuls before anyone could intervene.

我们所能做的……只有站在那里看着。
 All we could do... was stand there and watch.

喂……我们以前见过这场面，对吧？就是那种对……的渴求。
 Hey... We've seen this before, haven't we? It's that same craving for...
texts.speaker:
以实玛利
 Ishmael

texts.text:
……或许之前就有预兆。
 ... There might have been warning signs.
texts.speaker:
默尔索
 Meursault

texts.text:
红派不断吞噬百货公司，几乎要将其耗尽。
 The Rouges have been consuming the department store to the point of depletion.
texts.speaker:
默尔索
 Meursault

texts.text:
<而布布……一直说自己饿。>
 <And Pwie... kept saying they were hungry.>
texts.speaker:
但丁
 Dante

texts.text:
<难道布布一直在抵抗这种冲动……？>
 <Were they fighting it this entire time...?>
texts.speaker:
但丁
 Dante

texts.text:
布布……你还好吗？
 Pwie... Are you all right?
texts.speaker:
以实玛利
 Ishmael

texts.text:
布布呆呆望着手指间垂落的、湿漉漉的蠕蠕碎片，仿佛刚刚恢复神智。
 Pwie stared blankly at the wet pieces of Wriggley dangling between their fingers as if they'd just come back to their senses.

就像回头望见自己做过的事，才发现悔意已在那里等着。
 As though looking back at what they had done and finding regret waiting there.

顾客把茧吃了！现在可以把黄金皮革做成衣服了。
 The customer ate the cocoon! Now we can finish making a garment out of the Golden Hide.
texts.speaker:
培育者
 Nurturer

texts.text:
我……我以为自己是那个不会伤害蠕蠕的人。
 I... I thought I was the one who wouldn't hurt Wriggley.
texts.speaker:
布布
 Pwie

texts.text:
我从没想过……
 I never wanted to...
texts.speaker:
布布
 Pwie

texts.text:
……可眼前的一切都变红了。我太饿了……也太孤独了……
 ... but everything turned red. I was so hungry... and so lonely...
texts.speaker:
布布
 Pwie

texts.text:
……我再也见不到蠕蠕了，对吗？
 ... I'll never see Wriggley again, will I?
texts.speaker:
布布
 Pwie

texts.text:
……布布，若你愿意……我们可以在这里找一只和蠕蠕模样相同的茧。可是……
 ... Pwie, should you wish it... We could scour this place for another cocoon identical in form to Wriggley. Yet...
texts.speaker:
李箱
 Yi Sang

texts.text:
那也不是蠕蠕……只会是另一只茧。
 It would not be Wriggley... but merely another cocoon.
texts.speaker:
李箱
 Yi Sang

texts.text:
好了……可以了。黄金皮革衣服缝好啦~嘻嘻。等楼层经理做完最终检验，就算彻底完成了。
 There... Good to go. The Golden Hide garment is sewn~ Hee hee. Once the Floor Manager gives it a final inspection, it'll finally be completed.
texts.speaker:
培育者
 Nurturer

texts.text:
做得不错……我的愉快回忆清单上又能添一件事了。
 It turned out well... Another thing to go on my list of pleasant memories.
texts.speaker:
培育者
 Nurturer

texts.text:
……看来我的孩子们已经做好了黄金皮革衣服。光泽诱人。
 ... I see my children have completed the Golden Hide garment. APPEALING SHEEN.
texts.speaker:
监工
 Overseer

texts.text:
是的。你要价多少？
 Yes. What is your price?
texts.speaker:
默尔索
 Meursault

texts.text:
必须在此进行最终检验。请稍候。动机上升。
 Final inspection must be performed here. Please wait. MOTIVATION RISING.
texts.speaker:
监工
 Overseer

texts.text:
……啊，原来是这种手感。纹理保留得真漂亮。时隔这么多个季度，黄金高级定制终于再次出现……我的面孔都在悸动。缝线检验完成。
 ... Ah, so this is what it feels like. The grain is beautifully preserved. Golden haute couture, after so many seasons... my faces are throbbing. STITCHING INSPECTION COMPLETE.
texts.speaker:
监工
 Overseer

texts.text:
检验完了，可以还给我们了吗？
 Can we have it back if you're done?
texts.speaker:
以实玛利
 Ishmael

texts.text:
稍等……最后再检查一次，有没有线头、污渍或污染……
 One moment... one final check for loose threads, stains, or contamination...
texts.speaker:
监工
 Overseer

texts.text:
当然不会有任何瑕疵。我们的工序天衣无缝……贪欲超出安全水平。
 Naturally, no defect will exist. Our process is flawless... GREED EXCEEDING SAFE LEVELS.
texts.speaker:
监工
 Overseer

texts.text:
他每呼吸一次，似乎就把衣服攥得更紧……
 He appears to clutch the garment more tightly with every passing breath...
texts.speaker:
李箱
 Yi Sang

texts.text:
还给我们。你想要多少眼球，我们都付……
 Give it back. We'll pay however many eyeballs you want...
texts.speaker:
以实玛利
 Ishmael

texts.text:
你明知道，光靠眼球还不够……不足以成为黄金皮革的主人。事实修正。
 You know that eyeballs are not enough... to become the owner of Golden Hide. FACT REVISED.
texts.speaker:
监工
 Overseer

texts.text:
给陌生人太可惜了。这是黄金高级定制，是我们最出色的杰作。谁也别想拿走……开始攻击。
 Much too good for strangers. This is the Golden Haute Couture, our finest masterpiece. No one can have it... COMMENCING ATTACK.
texts.speaker:
监工
 Overseer

texts.text:
……拜托了，真是——
 ... Oh, for the love of—
texts.speaker:
以实玛利
 Ishmael

texts.text:
不用再启动机器了。
 No need to activate the machine again.
(임시) 공정이 끝나기 전엔 여기를 떠날 수 없다.
texts.speaker:
默尔索
 Meursault

texts.text:
直到杀死监工，我们才终于夺回了做好的黄金皮革衣服。
 Only after killing the Overseer could we finally take the completed Golden Hide garment back.

多么完美的黄金高级定制……不能交给你们这些陌生人。所有面孔的贪欲均已达到最高等级。
 What a perfectly crafted Haute Couture of gold... Can't let you strangers have it. ALL FACES MAXIMUM GREED LEVEL REACHED.
texts.speaker:
监工
 Overseer

texts.text:
*尖鸣*
 *scree*
texts.speaker:
茧
 Cocoon

texts.text:
又来了个我不认识的人。
 Another person I don't know.
texts.speaker:
布布
 Pwie

texts.text:
搞什么……这是怎么回事？希斯克利夫一直念叨着要带孩子，我还当他又在照例抱怨，结果……
 What the... What is all this? Heathcliff kept going on and on about babysitting, so I just took it as his usual grumbling, and turns out...
texts.speaker:
以实玛利
 Ishmael

texts.text:
<……说来话长。默尔索，你能向她解释一下发生了什么吗？>
 <... It's a long story. Meursault, can you explain to her what happened?>
texts.speaker:
但丁
 Dante

texts.text:
……是，经理。
 ... Yes, Manager.
texts.speaker:
默尔索
 Meursault

texts.text:
默尔索向以实玛利说明了事情经过。
 Meursault caught Ishmael up to speed.

与此同时，这里是最后一层地下楼层。
 This place, meanwhile, was the final underground floor.

默尔索和我以前都没有到过这里。
 Neither Meursault nor I had reached this place before.

我们必须在这里为布布制作黄金裹布——一件用黄金皮革做的衣服。
 This is where we have to fashion Pwie's Golden Shroud—an outfit made from Golden Hide.

布布穿着它进入五楼后会发生什么，谁也说不准。
 What would happen if Pwie entered the fifth floor wearing it was anyone's guess.

但我们要的正是这份未知。我们需要一个机会，让任何一件事出现不同的结果。
 But that uncertainty was the point. We needed the chance to make something, anything, turn out differently.

正是如此，进入五楼的关键，就是让那个孩子穿上黄金皮革制成的衣服……
 Indeed, the key to the fifth floor is that the child be arrayed in clothing fashioned from Golden Hide...
texts.speaker:
李箱
 Yi Sang

texts.text:
这里每个人似乎都急着把黄金皮革据为己有，想做好这件衣服恐怕不轻松。
 And since everyone here seems desperate to own Golden Hide, making the outfit is not going to be a walk in the park.
texts.speaker:
以实玛利
 Ishmael

texts.text:
我们的眼球还够吗？趁别人开出天价之前，最好先算一算……
 Do we still have enough eyeballs? We should do the math before anyone starts asking for prices through the roof...
texts.speaker:
以实玛利
 Ishmael

texts.text:
以实玛利看起来恨不得把账本核对到最后一颗眼球。
 Ishmael looked ready to balance a ledger down to the last eyeball.

等等。我们花了那么多眼球……就为了这一件东西？唉。
 Wait. We paid through the nose in eyeballs... for this one item? *sigh*
texts.speaker:
以实玛利
 Ishmael

texts.text:
<我是说……那是我们当时最好的选择……>
 <I mean, it was the best option we had at the time...>
texts.speaker:
但丁
 Dante

texts.text:
钱已付过。除了好好利用买来的东西，恐怕也别无他法……
 The price has already been paid. There is little recourse but to put the purchase to good use...
texts.speaker:
李箱
 Yi Sang

texts.text:
一具红派的尸体。
 A Rouge's corpse.

缝线全都崩开了，只剩下一团破碎不堪的残骸。
 The stitches have all burst, leaving it a shredded mess.

架子上挂着几块剖得很薄的皮革。
 Several pieces of thinly split leather are hanging on the rack.

它们薄得能透见另一面。
 They've been split so thinly that the other side is visible.

它还在流血，浸透了下方的地面。
 It's still bleeding, soaking the ground beneath it.

厚实的全粒面皮革。看起来很有分量。
 Thick, full grain leather. Looks pretty weighty.

这块皮革摸起来湿润。
 This piece of leather is moist to the touch.

这块皮革已经干缩，皱成一团。
 This piece of leather has been desiccated and shrunk into a wrinkly mess.

这块皮革的切面仿佛是被极锋利的刀刃切开的。
 The cross-section of this cut of leather looks as though it's been cut by an incredibly keen blade.

这块皮革的切面——如果还能称之为切面的话——显然是被钝刀撕开的。
 The cross-section of this cut of leather—if it can be called that—clearly communicates that it's been ripped by a dull knife.

这块皮革上有好几个……脓疱。散发出骇人的恶臭。
 There are multiple... pustules on this cut of leather. It emits a horrible stench.

摊开晾晒的人皮。
 Human leather that's been laid out to dry.

里面有发黑的血珠，明显已经变了色。
 There are blackened beads of blood with clear signs of discoloration inside.

下颌部位有几处奇怪的孔洞，让人想起鱼鳃。
 There are strange holes reminiscent of gills on the jaw area.

这些皮革还泛着红色，想必刚剥下来不久。
 These pieces of leather still retain their reddish hue. Must've been flayed recently.

只掀起一个小角，就有一股令人作呕的恶臭扑面而来。
 Lifting a small corner of it immediately releases a rush of revolting stench.
里面有几块绿色的皮革。大概已经腐烂了。 There are green patches of leather inside. Must be rotten.

只掀起一个小角，就有一股令人作呕的恶臭扑面而来。
 Lifting a small corner of it immediately releases a rush of revolting stench.

这些也许是弃置的皮革，就像一楼角落里那堆被丢弃的衣服……？
 Maybe these are discarded leather, like those piles of clothes discarded in corners of the first floor...?

皮革边角料。应该是留着做补丁用的。
 Scraps of leather. Must've been saving these to be used as extra patches.

这块上面还有指甲……
 This one still has fingernails...

几块皮革胡乱散落着。
 Pieces of leather haphazardly strewn about.

暗红的干涸血迹黏住了几缕头发。
 Dark-red patches of dried blood have caught some strands of hair.

里面塞满了浸烂的皮革。
 It's full of macerated leather.

纸条上写着：[废弃]。
 The note reads: [DISPOSAL].

看来有一阵子没用了。有些部件已经生锈。
 Must've been a while since this was used. Parts of it has rusted.

与其说是皮革，更像是标本。
 More taxidermy than leather.

这块皮革简直油光发亮。看起来比外面晾晒的那些品质更好。
 This piece of leather is practically glistening. It looks to be of a higher quality than the ones drying outside.

这块……脸皮上的表情还挺愉悦。
 It's got a pleasant expression, this... patch of face skin.

闻不到任何气味。应该经过了某种处理。
 Doesn't smell like anything. Must've gone through some sort of treatment process.

每一缕头发都闪着生命力的光泽，看起来生机勃勃。
 Each strand of hair is glistening with vitality. Looks lively.

这块皮革仍然相当湿润。
 This piece of leather is still quite moist.

这些皮革都是从哪里来的？
 Where do all these pieces of leather come from?

摊开晾晒的人皮。
 Human leather that's been laid out to dry.

……真恶心。
 ... This is disgusting.
texts.speaker:
以实玛利
 Ishmael

texts.text: 他们仿佛把人体像多面体的平面展开图一样，展开了…… It is as though they have unfolded the body, akin to the planar figure of a polyhedron, only human...
texts.speaker:
李箱
 Yi Sang

texts.text:
这景象实在不适合让孩子看见。
 This is a sight most inapt for the eyes of children.
texts.speaker:
李箱
 Yi Sang

texts.text:
李箱小心地挪到一旁，挡住布布，不让布布看那块皮革。
 Yi Sang carefully moved to the side, blocking Pwie from looking at the piece of leather.

可想到我们身在何处……这么做恐怕也没多大用。
 Considering where we are, however... I don't think it'll do much good.

呃……这味道……比鲸鱼的气味还难闻。
 Ugh... That smell... It's even worse than Whale odor.
texts.speaker:
以实玛利
 Ishmael

texts.text:
*嗅嗅* *嗅嗅*
 *sniff* *sniff*
texts.speaker:
布布
 Pwie

texts.text:
好香。
 Smells good.
texts.speaker:
布布
 Pwie

texts.text: ……真的吗？这个味道？ ... Really? This smell?
texts.speaker:
以实玛利
 Ishmael

texts.text:
嗯。闻起来香喷喷的，味道很浓。
 Mhm. Smells savory and rich.
texts.speaker:
布布
 Pwie

texts.text:
他们把它闻成那样，倒也并不奇怪。
 It is not so out of the ordinary for them to perceive it as such.
texts.speaker:
默尔索
 Meursault

texts.text:
食物脱水是一道工序，能更鲜明地呈现食材独有的风味。
 Food dehydration is a process by which the ingredient's unique flavors may be more vividly conveyed.
texts.speaker:
默尔索
 Meursault

texts.text:
默尔索，你也觉得它闻起来好吃吗？
 Does it smell tasty to you too, Meursault?
texts.speaker:
布布
 Pwie

texts.text:
如果这是肉干，而非皮革……我想我也会觉得香。
 Had this been jerky rather than leather... I imagine it would have smelled good to me, too.
texts.speaker:
默尔索
 Meursault

texts.text:
有什么区别？
 What's the difference?
texts.speaker:
布布
 Pwie

texts.text:
布布的问题一个接一个，默尔索耐心地一一回答。
 Meursault patiently answered Pwie's questions as they kept coming.
一股气流从皮革堆里喷出，发出嘶——的一声。 Air rushes out of the pile of leather with a shhh.

<……里面怎么了？默尔索，我们看看。>
 <... What's going on in there? Meursault, let's take a look.>
texts.speaker:
但丁
 Dante

texts.text:
默尔索掀起皮革堆。气体逸出的声音在我们耳中渐渐变成了喘息。
 Meursault lifts the pile of leather, and the sound of escaping air slowly turns into wheezing to our ears.

找了一阵后，我们终于找到了发出声音的那块皮革。
 After some searching, we managed to find the piece of leather that was making the noise.

……这里刻着“恶心的叛徒”，经理。
 ... The words "Disgusting turncoat," is inscribed here, Manager.
texts.speaker:
默尔索
 Meursault

texts.text:
默尔索展开那块皮革，露出了它的全貌。那张……“嘴”一开一合，似乎想说些什么。
 Meursault unrolled the piece of leather. Its full form now visible. the... "mouth" opened and closed, trying to communicate something.

<它……在说话吗？说了什么？>
 <Is it... saying something? What is it saying?>
texts.speaker:
但丁
 Dante

texts.text:
……“请撕开我。”一直在重复。
 ... "Please rip me." Repeatedly.
texts.speaker:
默尔索
 Meursault

texts.text:
<照它说的做吧。>
 <Let's do as it asks.>
texts.speaker:
但丁
 Dante

texts.text:
是，经理。
 Yes, Manager.
texts.speaker:
默尔索
 Meursault

texts.text:
默尔索扯住那块皮革，慢慢将它撕成两半。
 Meursault pulls on the piece of leather, slowly tearing it in half.

皮肤被缓缓撕开时，那块皮革露出了狂喜的笑容。
 The leather smiles ecstatically as its skin is slowly ripped apart.

看起来像一件……被剥去皮肤组织的装置艺术。
 Looks like an... installation with its skin tissue removed.

我能感觉到极微弱的气息从它口中逸出。它还活着。
 I can feel the smallest hint of air escaping its mouth. It's still alive.

一块被拉成双翼形状的剥下来的皮革。
 Flayed leather that has been pulled into the shape of a pair of wings.

融化的皮肤组织和地板黏成了一体。
 Melted skin tissue has merged to the floor.

这块皮革大概刚从加工工序中取出，摸起来还有些温热。
 This piece of leather must've been just removed from processing. It's still quite warm to the touch.

漆黑的桶里有什么，很难看清。
 It's hard to see what's inside the dark barrel.

听起来几乎像在痛苦呻吟。
 Almost sounds like it's groaning in pain.

这是一口大缸……或者说，一只能大量加工皮革的桶。
 It's a big vat... or a barrel capable of bulk-processing a large amount of leather.

它被剖成了许多许多薄层，已经很难猜出原来的模样。
 It's been split into many, many thin layers, making it difficult to guess its original form.

浸泡过化学药剂的皮革上，一簇簇头发正液化脱落。
 Patches of hair are liquefying and melting off from the chemical-soaked leather.

刺鼻的恶臭冲入鼻腔。
 A sharp stench stings the nose.

化学液体在里面晃荡。碰到它，显然会对皮肤造成……不良影响。
 Chemical fluid is swishing inside. Touching it will clearly have... adverse effects for the skin.

液体闻起来酸酸的。
 The liquid smells sour.

这些皮革被绷得很紧。
 These patches of leather are pulled taut.

它们是在接受某种特殊处理吗？
 Are they going through some sort of special treatment process?

一缸液体，血中混着各种半融化的残渣。
 A vat of fluid, with various half-melted dregs mixed into blood.

黏稠的液体里，气泡懒洋洋地浮上来，然后破裂。
 Bubbles lazily float up the viscous fluid before popping.

我注意到油腻的液体中漂着一层白色脂肪。
 I notice a white layer of fat floating among the greasy fluid.

……是什么把地板融化了？
 ... Did something melt the floor?

这味道真恶心。
 This smells disgusting.

无法辨认的肉块漂浮在液体中。
 Unrecognizable bits of flesh are floating about the fluid.

这分明是多种剧毒化学药剂调成的混合液。
 This is clearly a cocktail of highly toxic chemicals.

……瞥见一大团白色的东西，上面还长着头发。
 ... Caught the briefest glimpse of a large, white glob with hair growing out of it.

你是顾客吗？在这儿等着，我去拿账本。
 Are you a customer? Wait here, let me get my ledger.
texts.speaker:
刮肉工
 Scraper

texts.text:
闻到了高评级顾客的香气。有钱的陌生人总是受欢迎。
 Getting a whiff of a high-Prestige customer's fragrance. Loaded strangers are always welcome.
texts.speaker:
监工
 Overseer

texts.text:
黏稠的黑血从它的每一个毛孔里渗出。
 Viscous, black blood wells up in each of its pores.

胡乱缝补的皮革上露出几块肉。
 There are bits of meat sticking out of the haphazardly patched-up leather.

头骨像西瓜一样被砸碎，上面还连着几小撮头发。
 A skull smashed in like a watermelon. There are small patches of hair still attached to it.

遭到那位工匠袭击，着实出乎意料。
 It was a most unexpected development to fall under the assault of the artisan.
texts.speaker:
李箱
 Yi Sang

texts.text: 好吧，它晃动身体的时候，呃……会有人从它的洞里爬出来。它的行为出人意料地像穴掌鲸，只不过这里不是大湖，不是它平常栖息的地方。 Okay, so when it shakes its body, uh... people crawl out of its hole. Its behavior is surprisingly similar to the Whale of the Porous hand, just not in its usual habitat of the Great Lake.
texts.speaker:
以实玛利
 Ishmael

texts.text:
<至少那些小人鱼还被束缚在鲸鱼身上……>
 <At least those tiny Mermaids were bound to the Whale...>
texts.speaker:
但丁
 Dante

texts.text:
您要调整战术吗？
 Will you adjust your strategy?
texts.speaker:
默尔索
 Meursault

texts.text:
<它准备向我们冲过来时，多加小心。>
 <Let's try to watch out when it's getting ready to charge at us.>
texts.speaker:
但丁
 Dante

texts.text:
<还有……对，尽快解决从它背上爬出来的手下。>
 <And... yeah, quickly dispatch its minions that crawled out of its back.>
texts.speaker:
但丁
 Dante

texts.text:
这么久没碰到这种珍贵皮革，能加工它是我的荣幸。好好爱惜它。
 It was an honor to work on such precious leather after such a long drought of it. Take good care of it.
texts.speaker:
制革工
 Tanner

texts.text:
手掌向内蜷着，仿佛还攥着什么东西。
 The palm is curled inward, as though still clutching something.

<我们得快走。我想它听见了茧临死前的叫声……正循着声音朝我们追来。>
 <We need to get away. I think it caught the cocoon's death cry... and now it's following the sound straight back to us.>
texts.speaker:
但丁
 Dante

texts.text:
想跑？除非“声音”送你们一阵顺风，否则甩不掉哀嚎者。
 Trying to run? You won't shake the Wailer unless the Voice puts wind at your back.
texts.speaker:
刮肉工
 Scraper

texts.text: <它快到了。不管会到洗手间还是楼上，我们现在就得走。默尔索！动手！> now. Meursault! Do your thing!>
texts.speaker:
但丁
 Dante

texts.text:
遵命。
 It will be done.
texts.speaker:
默尔索
 Meursault

texts.text:
……空气里弥漫着浓重的油味，一点也勾不起食欲。
 ...A strong oily smell hangs in the air. There's nothing appetizing about it.

浸透油的皮革正在晾干。
 The oil-soaked leather is drying out.

浑浊、颜色古怪的油噼啪作响，四处飞溅，仿佛马上就要沸腾溢出。
 Murky, strange-colored oil crackles and spits as though on the verge of boiling over.

掠过的影子之间传来交谈声。
 Voices can be heard among the passing shadows.

就为了这么一块破皮，你打算折腾到什么时候？
 How far are you gonna go over one lousy hide?
texts.speaker:
不耐烦的顾客
 Impatient Customer

texts.text:
快换季了，我们也该往上走了……随便拿块皮革不行吗？
 The season's gonna change soon and we're due to move up anyway... can't we just bring any old leather?
texts.speaker:
不耐烦的顾客
 Impatient Customer

texts.text:
不行，绝对不行。
 Nope. Definitely not.
texts.speaker:
固执的顾客
 Adamant Customer

texts.text:
皮革穿得越久……就越贴合你的身体。
 The more you break leather in... the more it molds itself to you.
texts.speaker:
固执的顾客
 Adamant Customer

texts.text:
颜色、褶皱，甚至活动起来的样子……都会越来越像我！
 The color, the creases, even the way it moves... it all starts to take after me!
texts.speaker:
固执的顾客
 Adamant Customer

texts.text:
那边的皮革……还没穿得和我贴合。
 Those leathers over there... they haven't been broken in to me.
texts.speaker:
固执的顾客
 Adamant Customer

texts.text:
一位顾客的模糊身影始终徘徊在原地。
 A hazy figure of a customer keeps lingering in the same spot.

……空气里弥漫着浓重的油味，一点也勾不起食欲。
 ...A strong oily smell hangs in the air. There's nothing appetizing about it.

在肉块之间挖出了几颗眼球。
 Found some eyeballs buried between chunks of meat.

纸条上写着：[废弃]。
 The note reads: [DISPOSAL].

浸透油的皮革正在晾干。
 The oil-soaked leather is drying out.

浑浊、颜色古怪的油噼啪作响，四处飞溅，仿佛马上就要沸腾溢出。
 Murky, strange-colored oil crackles and spits as though on the verge of boiling over.
